(()=>{const radios=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-permission [role=radio]')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()+':'+b.getAttribute('aria-checked'));const mirror=document.querySelector('.assistant-permission input');const small=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-permission [role=radio]')].filter(b=>b.getBoundingClientRect().height<36).length;if(!radios.some(r=>r.startsWith('Ask before edits:true')))throw Error('Ask mode is not the default: '+radios.join(','));if(mirror.checked)throw Error('Mirror checkbox should be unchecked in ask mode');if(!!document.querySelector('label.assistant-permission'))throw Error('Old checkbox label still present');return {radios,mirror:mirror.checked,small}})()

(()=>{const ta=document.querySelector('#live-assistant-prompt');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(ta,"Draw one wall from (0, 0) to (3000, 0) on the Ground level, 2700 mm high. Do nothing else.");ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return ta.value.length})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.assistant-permission-card'))return 'card already shown';const pill=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-reply-options:not([data-stale]) .assistant-pill')].find(b=>/sketch/i.test(b.textContent));if(pill){window.__replies=document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-assistant').length;pill.click();return 'answered the Sketch-or-Model question with the pill: '+pill.textContent.trim().slice(0,60)}const ta=document.querySelector('#live-assistant-prompt');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(ta,'Sketch mode.');ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('[aria-label="Send assistant message"]').click();return 'answered Sketch mode by message'})()

(()=>{const c=document.querySelector('.assistant-permission-card');const text=c.querySelector('.assistant-permission-card-text').textContent;if(/[{}\[]|":/.test(text))throw Error('Permission card shows JSON: '+text);const buttons=[...c.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim());const small=[...c.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>b.getBoundingClientRect().height<44).length;if(small)throw Error(small+' permission buttons under 44 px');return {text,buttons,receiptsSoFar:document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-tool-row').length}})()

(()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-tool-row')].map(r=>r.querySelector('.assistant-tool-title').textContent+' · '+r.querySelector('.assistant-tool-summary').textContent);const raw=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-tool')].map(e=>e.textContent);const drew=raw.some(t=>t.startsWith('draw_architect_elements')&&/Tool result/.test(t)&&/"created"/.test(t));if(!drew)throw Error('No draw receipt after Allow once: '+rows.join(' | '));const w=document.querySelector('.architect-workspace');const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(w.dataset.designId)));return {rows,walls:d.walls.length,revision:d.revision,card:!!document.querySelector('.assistant-permission-card')}})()

(()=>{const ta=document.querySelector('#live-assistant-prompt');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(ta,"Now draw a second wall from (0, 0) to (0, 3000) on Ground. If you cannot, say why in one sentence.");ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return ta.value.length})()

(()=>{const raw=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-tool')].map(e=>e.textContent);const refused=raw.some(t=>/Read-only mode/.test(t));const drew=raw.slice(window.__rowsBefore).some(t=>t.startsWith('draw_architect_elements')&&/"created"/.test(t));const walls=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(document.querySelector('.architect-workspace').dataset.designId))).walls.length;if(drew||walls!==window.__wallsBefore)throw Error('A wall was drawn in read-only mode');const reply=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-assistant')].at(-1)?.textContent.slice(0,300);const card=!!document.querySelector('.assistant-permission-card');if(card)throw Error('Read-only mode should not prompt');return {refusedReceipt:refused,walls,reply}})()
